decomposition.discrimination_note: no discrimination at the reported precision: the forecasts realised 0.0 of the discrimination this sample had available (0.0 of 0.0019550267113437824), which prints as 0.0000 at the 4 decimal places these terms are reported at. Read that as none rather than as a small amount of it -- the recalibrated forecasts are climatology to within the reported precision, so the resolution beside it is a rounding artefact and not a measurement of weak skill

unavailable.log_score: the forecast assigned probability 0 to an event that occurred, so the mean negative log likelihood is infinite. It is not clipped: a clip replaces an infinite loss with a finite one chosen by whoever picked the clip, and hides the failure worth seeing

metrics.reference: climatology_exceedance, refitted on each fold's training rows

splits.by_day_type: the scored day's first applicable type: last business day of a quarter, of a month, the tax window (data.tax_date), a coupon settlement day (treasury_settlement_coupons > 0), else other
splits.by_regime: provisional: calendar periods, the slices of docs/pivot/lag-assessment.md section 2, until a declared regime state exists

refused_columns.mmf_assets: sec_nmfp: a snapshot_retrieved_at source is priced from rows only for a field declaring revision_policy in ['never_revised'] with revision_evidence. A row's available_at says when it arrived, not whether the latest vintage is the value that stood on the day
